sn:script.sn:pointer: A mysterious force surrounds the area. You may use a Tent or Cottage, and save your game.[end]
[bold]Golbez[normal]: It's over...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: The fool... He had such fantastic powers, yet he let an evil heart lead him astray...[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Yahoo!![end]
[bold]Rydia[normal]: This is horrible...[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Damn it all!!![end]
[bold]Rydia[normal]: Can't...can't we do anything?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: What's that!?[end]
[bold]Cid[normal]: As long as I'm here, you've got nothing to worry about! Pedal to the metal, boys!![end]
[bold]Edward[normal]: Cecil! I'll show you the courage that you taught me![end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: We're too late! And I was supposed to be the one to pound that guy![new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: Cecil...[end]
[bold]Jiott[normal]: The Dwarf Tank Force is here! For the sake of Mother Earth, we will fight too![end]
[bold]Yang[normal]: I cannot rest as long as the world is in danger![end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Oh, I see! So we hit it right in the heart![end]

[bold]Palom[normal]: Well, that's basically the deal.[new] [bold]Porom[normal]: I'm sorry we deceived you. But we had no choice.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: No, I understand. Considering what I did, that was to be expected.[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: But you overcame your past self and became a Paladin...![new] ...!? That sword?![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: I received it on the summit of the mountain.[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: This is...![new] The very words of the legend handed down in Mysidia since ancient times are engraved on it![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Legend?[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Let's just hope nobody controls you again.[end]
[bold]Cain[normal]: ...If that happens, don't hold back... Kill me![end]
[bold]Cain[normal]: ....I'm going too. I have a score I have to settle with this Zemus![end]
[bold]Cain[normal]: Rosa...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Golbez came back to his senses too, so the spell was broken! It's not your fault, Cain![new] [bold]Cain[normal]: Golbez...too?[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Damn straight! It's your own damned fault that the Giant showed up in the first place![end]
[bold]Cain[normal]: Save the talk for later! Do you want to die?![end]

[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: This is the Giant's Heart, the control system![new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Whoa, it's huge![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Before we attack the Control System we've got to destroy the Defense System, or else it'll repair itself![end]
[bold]Golbez[normal]: How dare you stop the Giant!![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: You!![end]
[bold]Golbez[normal]: Who are you!?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: You! Don't you even know who you are!?[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: No, stop!![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Wake up![end]

[bold]Golbez[normal]: ...Why was I so driven by hatred...?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: ...You've come back to yourself. ...Do you remember your father's name?[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: My father... KluYa...?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: WHAT!?[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Then he's Cecil's...[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Brother!?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Golbez is my...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: You were being used through Zemus's telepathy... KluYa's Lunarian blood in you only made it stronger...[new] Brothers fighting each other...![end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: Hey, old man![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: I hated my own brother... and fought him...[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: You're my...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: But... it could have been the other way around... If Zemus's telepathy had reached me instead...[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: ...But if it reached me, then there must have been evil in my heart to begin with... Zemus...!![end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: Where are you going!?[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: I'm going to end this myself![end]
[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Zemus is also of our race! I'll come with you...!![end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: You sure about this, Cecil?[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Golbez... He means to die...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: He's your brother, isn't he?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...Brother...[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: That's right![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Th-this is bad![new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: We've got to get out of here![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Cecil![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: What are you doing!?[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: But where's the way out!?[new] 'This way!'[end]
[bold]Rosa[normal]: Cain![new] [bold]Edge[normal]: We won't fall for that![end]
[bold]Cain[normal]: I've finally taken back control of my own heart...[new] I won't ask you to forgive me after all this, but...[end]

[bold]Rosa[normal]: Golbez was Cecil's brother...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: It seems a Lunarian named Zemus was using Golbez's Lunarian blood.[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: So Golbez went to the moon with FuSoYa to defeat Zemus.[new] [bold]Cain[normal]: Golbez... Cecil's brother...[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Then I'm going too! I won't be satisfied until I've landed a blow on that guy![new] [bold]Cain[normal]: Edge...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Let's go...[end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: I'm going to the moon too![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Cecil...[end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Now, the kid stays home and behaves herself.[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: Idiot![end]

[bold]Rosa[normal]: ...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Get out of the way...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: No! Unless you take me with you, I'm not moving an inch.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: What...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: As long as I can be by your side[music][0x13], whatever happens... no, as long as I'm with you, I don't care how dangerous things are...![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Rosa...[new] [bold]Cain[normal]: ...Nothing for it, Cecil.[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Lucky guy.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: All right, Rosa... I'll... I'll protect you![end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: You!![new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: I told you once, didn't I? This is everybody's fight. Besides, I'm the only one who can call the Phantoms![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Rydia... All right... Let's go! Into our fight![end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Rosa and Rydia, you stay here. The three of us will go by ourselves.[new] This time there's no guarantee that we'll come back alive...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Cecil![new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: Are you joking!?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Come on, get off the Magical Ship![end]
'I am...pure darkness... Augmented by Zemus' hatred...'[end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: Zeromus...! I can't... I can't lose...![end]
'...I...will not...perish... As long as...evil...dwells in the hearts...of the living... Gu...zu... Gyaaaaaaam!!!!'[end]
[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: To think that you held so much power within you... The people of the Blue Planet may have already surpassed us Lunarians.[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Hey, maybe you're right![end]

[bold]Village Elder[normal]: You're the one from that day... What business brings you here this time?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: My name is Cecil, and I was the commander of Baron's airship force.[new] Back then, I didn't have the courage to disobey the King's orders...[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Your apology won't bring back the people who died.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: However... I see a glimmer of a different light in you now.[new] It might be worth listening to what you have to say.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: I'm fighting Golbez, the man who is controlling Baron.[new] But one of my friends was captured, and on our way to save her, Leviathan attacked us, and my other friends...[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: ...That too must be a trial set before you.[new] But as long as you rely on the Dark Sword, not only will you fail to defeat true evil...[new] your own heart may be stained by evil at any moment.[new] If you wish to fight with a good heart, go to Mt. Ordeals in the east. A great destiny should await you there.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: But I must hurry and save my friend![new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Someone dear to you, is she? But you must not be hasty![new] You seem to carry a great destiny... First, climb Mt. Ordeals. You must turn that evil sword into a holy one.[new] It is said that one who can accept the holy light becomes a Holy Knight... a Paladin.[new] Many have gone to Mt. Ordeals with that aim, but not one has ever returned.[new] ...Well, will you go?[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...Yes![new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: But it will be hard alone, with your Dark Sword. I'll send Magicians with you.[new] Palom! Porom![end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Who are you...?[new] [bold]Old Man[normal]: I am FuSoYa, guardian of the sleeping people of the Moon, the Lunarians.[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Lunarians?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Indeed. It was a very long time ago...[new] The planet that lay between the fourth and fifth planets of the solar system faced its extinction.[new] The survivors escaped on a ship to the Blue Planet...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: The Blue Planet...?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: The planet that you live on. But its creatures were still evolving, so we created another moon and fell into a long sleep there...[end]

[bold]Edge[normal]: So those are...the Lunarians.[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: But one of us refused to sleep![new] He wanted to burn every living thing off the Blue Planet so that we could settle there.[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: How awful...![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: ...I sealed him away. But during the long sleep, his mind grew stronger![new] His thoughts made the evil ones of your planet even more wicked... and drove them to gather the Crystals.[end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Then Golbez too was his...![new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Who is this guy!?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: His name is Zemus...! The Crystals are our source of energy.[new] He must have had them gathered to run the Dimensional Elevator in the Tower of Babil.[new] With the elevator, he means to send the Giant of Babil down to your planet and burn everything away...![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: No...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: But most Lunarians aren't like that.[new] We watch over the people of the Blue Planet until they have evolved enough to speak with us as equals...[new] We all sleep on...dreaming of that day...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: What about the Magical Ship that brought us here?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: ...Long ago, my younger brother, KluYa, built it and went down to the Blue Planet.[new] KluYa was enthralled with your unknown world... The Devil Road and the technology of airships came from him.[new] ...Then KluYa fell in love with a woman of the Blue Planet, and she bore him two children...[new] One of them...is you.[end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: !! Me...? Then the voice I heard on Mt. Ordeals was...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Your father... It was KluYa's spirit... I see now...you look so much like KluYa... when he was young...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: That voice was... my father...![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: KluYa gave you his power to stop Zemus's scheme. We must stop Zemus![new] For the Blue Planet, and for the people of the Moon! Now...hurry to the Tower of Babil in Eblana![new] [bold]Edge[normal]: The Tower of Babil!? But it's surrounded by a barrier![end]

[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: I have powers that can neutralize the barrier! We cannot let the Giant of Babil be unleashed upon the Blue Planet![new] I shall go with you! [space][0x8]Lunarian FuSoYa [space][0x7]joined the party![music][0x29][delay][0x28][end]
[bold]Cain[normal]: But about those final words that Zeromus left...[end]

[bold]Rosa[normal]: As long as evil hearts still exist...[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Evil hearts will never disappear... Everyone has both a holy heart and an evil one.[new] Just as the Crystals have light and dark, and your Blue Planet has a surface and an underworld...[new] But as long as evil hearts exist, holy hearts will exist too. Just as you, who stood up to Zemus's evil, had holy hearts...[new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Aw, all that praise is making me blush![end]
[bold]Rydia[normal]: What are you talking about? It's a wonder Zemus never used someone like you![end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: Heh heh, that's 'cause I love justice![new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: Well, it's time I returned to my sleep, too. And what will you do?[end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: We're going to return to our world.[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Everyone's waiting for us![end]
[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: I see. You have wonderful friends. I look forward to the day we meet again.[end]

[bold]Golbez[normal]: May I... May I go with you?[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: You?[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: Yes... I...can't go back. Not after what I've done.[new] And I'd also like to meet my father's people.[new] [bold]FuSoYa[normal]: I see...You also have Lunarian blood flowing in your veins... But it will be a long sleep.[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: I know.[end]

[bold]Golbez[normal]: You called me brother... Cecil.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: ...[new] [bold]Golbez[normal]: ...I suppose you could never forgive me. Not after all the suffering I've caused you all...[end]
[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: We must go now... I pray for peace on the Blue Planet.[end]
[bold]Rosa[normal]: Cecil...[new] [bold]Cain[normal]: Are you sure? Letting him go...[new] [bold]Rydia[normal]: He's your brother![end]

[bold]Village Elder[normal]: All right! Let's begin today's training.[delay][0x20][new] [bold]Porom[normal]: Yes, sir. [delay][0x1c][new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Hm? Where's Palom?[new] [bold]Porom[normal]: Not again!![delay][0x1c][close_window][end]
[bold]Palom[normal]: And then, with my trusty Blizzard spell, up on Mt. Ordeals...[delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Palom[normal]: Ow-ow-ow![new] [bold]Porom[normal]: That's enough out of you! The Elder is furious![delay][0x1d][close_window][end]

[bold]Village Elder[normal]: How many times do I have to tell you? Acting like that, you're ten years too early to dream of becoming Tellah![delay][0x20][new] As punishment, you'll copy out your spells![delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Chamberlain[normal]: ...And furthermore, you lack the discipline to be an effective ruler...[delay][0x19][close_window][end]

[bold]Chamberlain[normal]: If you knew, you wouldn't spend every day chasing skirts![delay][0x20][new] [bold]Edge[normal]: Yes, yes![delay][0x18][new] [bold]Chamberlain[normal]: Once is enough![delay][0x10][close_window][end]
[bold]Edge[normal]: But, Rydia... There's no woman in this world as fine as you...[delay][0x18][close_window][end]
[bold]Leviathan[normal]: She's quite a girl, though.[new] [bold]Asura[normal]: Yes. Who would have thought she'd come back here again...[delay][0x1a][new] 'Rydia!'[delay][0x10][close_window][end]
[bold]Phantom Child[normal]: Hey, Rydia. How come I've got fangs? I wish I was like you, Rydia.[delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Rydia[normal]: What are you talking about? Humans and Phantoms are just the same.[delay][0x1c][close_window][end]
[bold]Asura[normal]: The Land of Phantoms has a bright future ahead, don't you think?[new] [bold]Leviathan[normal]: Mm![delay][0x19] She's a beauty, after all![delay][0x20][close_window][end]
'Sing us the Paladin song again!' [delay][0x10] [bold]Edward[normal]: Sure. But only once today's work is done.[new] You want the castle rebuilt soon, don't you?[delay][0x1e][close_window][end]
[bold]Edward[normal]: Watch over me from the sky, Anna.[new] I still have the people of Damcyan...![delay][0x19] Be good to Tellah up there...[delay][0x18][close_window][end]

[bold]Yang[normal]: You're a Queen now! Stop calling me 'Dear'...![delay][0x1d] [new] [bold]Yang's wife[normal]: Even so, I hate all that formal stuff![delay][0x18][new] [bold]Yang[normal]: Oops! It's time for training![delay][0x18][close_window][end]
[bold]Former King[normal]: Now, now. Yang will build us a new Fabul.[delay][0x1e][close_window][end]
[bold]Jiott[normal]: All right! Let's get working and fix up this castle![delay][0x18][close_window][end]
'Your Majesty! We don't have enough raw materials to do that, Lali!'[delay][0x19][close_window][end]
[bold]Jiott[normal]: The Tanks! Scrap the Tanks! We don't need 'em! There won't be any more wars![delay][0x19][close_window][end]
[bold]Luka[normal]: Father! I wonder how Cecil and the others are doing![delay][0x18][close_window][end]

[bold]Jiott[normal]: Good news on that front![new] Sir Cecil and Lady Rosa are to become King and Queen of Baron![new] [bold]Luka[normal]: Wow![delay][0x1d][new] [bold]Jiott[normal]: And word has come that they wish to invite us to the coronation![new] [bold]Luka[normal]: All right![delay][0x18][close_window][end]

[bold]Cain[normal]: Cecil... Rosa...[delay][0x1c][new] As I am now, I cannot give you my blessing...[new] I will hone my skills here on Mt. Ordeals... Once I have become a Dragon Knight greater than my father,[delay][0x20] I feel I could return to Baron...[new] Until then...[delay][0x20][close_window][end]

[bold]Rosa[normal]: What's wrong, Cecil? [delay][0x20][new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Nothing... I thought...I heard my brother's voice...[new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: What did he say...?[delay][0x20][close_window][end]

[bold]Cid[normal]: What the... Are the two of you STILL here!? [delay][0x20] What are you doing on a day like this?![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: Sorry, we got carried away.[delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Cid[normal]: Honestly! You'll have more than enough time for lovey-dovey stuff later![new] Come on now, Rosa![delay][0x20] ...Oh, no, I mean, my Queen![delay][0x18][close_window][end]

[bold]Cid[normal]: Really!? Well then, Rosa! A bride has to look her best! I've had the maids get everything ready![delay][0x20][new] So come on! Hurry up![new] [bold]Rosa[normal]: I'm coming![delay][0x20][close_window][end]

[bold]Rosa[normal]: It's been so long since we've last seen everyone. [delay][0x20] They should be coming about now! Cecil, hurry along![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: I will, Rosa.[delay][0x20][close_window][end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: I did hear it... I'm sure of it... My brother's voice... [delay][0x20] He said...'Good-bye'...[delay][0x18][close_window][end]
[bold]FuSoYa[normal]: ....Even in death, his hatred only grows...[end]
[bold]Golbez[normal]: Zemus... No, Zeromus! You will meet your end by my hands![end]
[bold]Zeromus[normal]: ...Suffer! Perish! Until everything is destroyed... My hatred will continue...[new] Now it is your turn... Come... ...into my darkness...![end]
[bold]Village Elder[normal]: Now the time has come for us to pray for them... ....no, we must pray for the earth![end]
[bold]Village Elder[normal]: Palom, Porom! We shall carry everyone's prayers to Sir Cecil![end]
[bold]Edward[normal]: Now is the time... for true courage...![end]
[bold]Jiott[normal]: The earth! Fight for the earth![end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: These two?[new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Indeed. These are the twin magicians, Palom and Porom.[new] They are still in training, but they will be of help to you. They are young, but I vouch for their talent.[new] [bold]Palom[normal]: Mysidia's child prodigy, the great Palom, is coming along, so you'd better be grateful![new] [bold]Village Elder[normal]: Palom! This is part of your training, too![end]
[bold]King Baron[normal]: Go to the Land of Phantoms, then come back here. I should be able to help you...[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Your Majesty![end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Your Majesty...[new] [bold]King Baron[normal]: Don't look so sad. A monster struck me down, but I gained eternal power.[new] Whenever the Summoner from Mist calls me, I will lend you my strength, as a Phantom who slays with a single blow.[new] But the law of the Land of Phantoms says I must test your strength. Don't let your guard down...![end]

[bold]King Baron[normal]: You have become strong... Fight for Baron... no, fight for the world! I will fight alongside you as Odin![new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: Your Majesty! [space][0x5]Rydia learned Odin![music][0x29][delay][0x28][end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: But that light... It called me... ...My son...[end]
[bold]Cecil[normal]: No, it's nothing... Let's go to bed...[end]

[bold]Cecil[normal]: Is everyone okay?[new] [bold]Cid[normal]: Yeah... But the Enterprise is shot. Trying to fly it would be dangerous.[new] [bold]Cecil[normal]: It can't be helped... Let's land.[end]
[bold]Porom[normal]: Please pardon his impudence. I'm his twin, Porom.[new] [bold]Palom[normal]: Geez, letting Baron use you like that![end]
